question: Why is all shining clearly perception with no agent-act recourse?
premises: All that shines beginning with thus is clearly perception.
But here there is no recourse through agent-act-part-instrumentality and the like.
inference: Shining itself is perception, and agent-act analysis has no purchase here.
plain_english: All that shines, beginning with thus — that is clearly perception; but here there is no recourse through agent-act-part-instrumentality and the like.
